ValidationRule.description: Primary and Invoicing contacts must be selected before moving the stage to proposal
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Proposal'), ISCHANGED(StageName) , OR(ISBLANK( Invoicing_Contact__c ), ISBLANK( Primary_Contact__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must identify and enter Primary and Invoicing contacts prior to proposal
